_readme: The freeplay menu's background: the main menu art, a colour wash over it, and a
checker that drifts across the whole thing forever. These are the built-in defaults -
the file is here so they can be changed without rebuilding. Back out of freeplay and
go back in; it is read fresh each time the menu is built.
Colours are AARRGGBB, the same way the capsule's position.json writes them. An alpha
of 00 on either checker square turns that half of the pattern off.
speed is pixels a second and direction is degrees, measuring the way the screen does:
0 drifts right, 90 down, 180 left, 270 up. tileSize is one square, so the pattern
repeats every two of them - which is also how long a full loop takes at a given speed.
blend is one of normal, add, multiply or screen.
tintColor washes menuDesat over menuBG, the same layer the main menu flashes pink on
its transitions. At tintOpacity 1 it covers the art underneath completely.
